title: Intelligent Software
headline: Reasoning in the service of action.
intro: The useful question is not whether software can generate an answer, but whether it can justify and safely act on one.
summary: Alchemy explores intention-aware services, structured language, governed automation, model interoperability and intelligent coordination with independent business authority.

sections.heading: Intentions are first-class
sections.body: A request may state a desired outcome without specifying every intermediate step. Intention-aware software can reason about goals and constraints while preserving explicit admission, authorisation and execution boundaries.

sections.heading: Structure beneath language
sections.body: Structured utterances, communications discovery and narrative services can retain why something was said, which evidence supports it, and which claims may be presented to a given audience.

sections.heading: Choice without lock-in
sections.body: LLMs and other specialists can be providers of capability. The surrounding object, service and governance contracts determine how their output is used; no model receives blanket authority because it sounds convincing.
